title: Dharm Yudh
textContentHtml:
1. This is the story of a supreme father!

2. At the time of mahabharat.

3. A father who looses his son in front of his eyes. A mere commander of his soldier army batallion at the time of mahabharat. From the side of Koravas. Whereas his son A was from side of pandavas.

4. He vitnesses the entire gita part where Sri Krishna teaches the dharma to the prince Arjuna. 

5. He then understands the reality of the world he was living in and gets free from it within that instant!

6. He tries to travel in other worlds except in the once that he has already died.

7. A takes lessons from him later on in the series.
